scenes.headline: How a small model writes a 3D scene
scenes.sub: A 4B fine-tune, its teacher's traces, and a browser
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tessel! This model turns a short brief into a whole Three.js scene, as one file a browser can run.

scenes.text: The student copies a teacher's long thinking and its code, always in one idiom: a single HTML file, one three.js import, hand-written camera controls.
scenes.say: It does not learn a library. It learns one idiom, taught by a larger model's long thinking and code.

steps.say: A short brief and a fixed system prompt go in.
First the model thinks, for about sixteen thousand tokens on average.
Then it writes the page, about twelve thousand eight hundred tokens of HTML.
A browser runs the file. No assets, no build step.

scenes.title: How it was trained
scenes.say: The recipe is plain supervised fine-tuning.

items.say: A larger model wrote four thousand one hundred and forty six scenes, each with its thinking.

items.text: Full fine-tune on all of it
items.say: The language layers train on every token, thinking included.
A short adapter pass uses a hundred and seventy eight rows that fit in sixteen thousand tokens.
A last full run ends at checkpoint eight. About sixty hours in total.

steps.note: every fourth layer is full attention
steps.say: Only every fourth layer keeps a key and a value for every past token.
That is two gibibytes of cache at sixty five thousand tokens. Thirty two cached layers would need eight.

scenes.label: The teacher's scenes that ran in Chromium
scenes.say: I ran all two hundred and thirteen of the teacher's scenes in a browser. Every one drew a scene, and none threw an error.

scenes.text: The corpus is clean. The student's own scenes needed 18 calls for 8 prompts, and eight calls looped.
scenes.say: The teacher's code runs. The student needed eighteen calls for eight scenes, and eight of them got stuck thinking.

recap: One idiom, taught by long traces
A hybrid keeps the cache small
scenes.say: One idiom, long traces, a small cache. And plan on retries.
